purpose: Switches between views of related content on the same page, such as a project's overview, activity and settings.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list

props.name: tabs
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean; content: React.ReactNode }>

props.name: orientation
props.description: Row or column. Defaults to horizontal

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: Automatic selects as arrows move; manual waits for Enter or Space. Defaults to automatic

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the selected tab id

whenToUse: For two to seven views of the same subject
When users switch between views often
whenNotToUse: For navigating between pages — use SideNav or links
For steps that must be done in order — use a stepper

anatomy: A tab list over a 1px divider; the selected tab has a 2px indicator; the panel below
states: `color-text-secondary` tabs, selected `color-text-link` with a `color-interactive-default` indicator; hover and press `color-state-layer`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`; disabled at `opacity-disabled`
motion: Layer over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: tablist named by its label; each tab controls a tabpanel
Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump; activation is automatic or manual
